headline: L1 Capital launches L1 Gold Fund (ASX: LGF) as a listed investment company with daily ASX liquidity, targeting gold equity mispricing via a long-short approach
reasoning: The L1 Gold Fund is structured as a listed investment company providing daily liquidity on ASX with a stable capital base, allowing management without short-term capital flow constraints and enabling the team to take advantage of market volatility. The strategy focuses on active stock picking in mispriced gold equities, leveraging L1's research resources built over close to 20 years of investing in the sector. Mark Landau and Rafi Lamb have each committed to very substantial personal investments in the strategy alongside a large investment from L1 Group, with over 90% of their investable wealth already in L1 funds. The long-short approach is designed to generate returns across a wide range of market environments without relying solely on a rising gold price.
quote: As a listed investment company, the L1 Gold Fund provides daily liquidity on the ASX and a stable capital base, allowing us to manage this strategy without the constraints of short-term capital flows, which enables us to take advantage of periods of market volatility. We expect this strategy to be durable and don't anticipate needing a rising gold price to support returns, as our long-short approach enables us to generate returns across a wide range of market environments. The gold equity's landscape is ripe with mispriced stocks, which plays into the strength of the L1 Capital investment approach, using our team's extensive resources and research to deliver attractive long-term returns.
episode_title: Introducing | L1 Gold Fund Limited (ASX: LGF)
